info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Application Document Submission API
info.description: The Loan Application Document Submission API enables users to upload and manage essential documents related to loan applications. This API facilitates the seamless submission of various documents required for processing loan requests. Typical consumers include financial institutions and loan officers who rely on accurate document management to expedite application processing. By using this API, businesses can enhance their operational efficiency and improve the client experience during the loan application process.

post.summary: Upload documents for a loan application.
post.description: This API endpoint allows users to upload necessary documents associated with a specific loan application identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the document format is compliant with the requirements for processing.

requestBody.description: The request body contains the necessary data for uploading documents related to the loan application identified by RES-100045. This payload must adhere to the specified JSON schema to ensure all required fields are populated correctly.

201.description: Successfully created a new document for the loan application.
